pinterest.title: Crete Wedding Packages: What They Include and What Sits Outside
pinterest.description: Two Crete wedding packages can carry the same name and share almost nothing on paper. Most bundle a ceremony set-up in a chosen space, and several add a coordinator. Guest rooms, sole use of a venue, the reception, extra hours and outside suppliers are where they part ways. Our guide sets out what Crete venue packages include, what sits outside them and how to lay two quotes side by side.

pinterest.title: Are Crete Wedding Packages All Inclusive? Read the List First
pinterest.description: On a Crete resort, all inclusive usually describes the holiday, not the wedding. A package includes what its list names, and the reception is the part most often quoted on its own, along with drinks, open bars and entertainment. Some resorts also tie a package to a minimum stay. Read the guide to see where Crete venues such as Euphoria, Abaton and Elounda SA draw the line.

pinterest.title: How to Compare Crete Wedding Package Quotes Like for Like
pinterest.description: Two Crete quotes rarely line up on first reading: one gives you a ceremony set-up, cake and coordinator, another a space, a venue fee and a list of extras. Put both on the same footing. Ask for every inclusion in writing, the guest count each quote is built on, deposit and cancellation terms, rooms and nights, music times, a weather plan, level access, supplier rules and the quote currency.

instagram_carousel.caption:
Two Crete wedding packages can carry the same name and share almost nothing on paper.

Our new guide sets out what Crete venue packages include, what sits outside them and how to lay two quotes side by side, with resorts from Elounda in the east to Kolymvari in the west.

Most packages bundle a ceremony set-up in a chosen space, and several add a coordinator. Guest rooms, the reception, extra hours and outside suppliers are where they part ways, and every resort draws that line in its own place.

A few things to ask every venue:
Is the reception inside the package, a separate menu or a separate quote?
Does the package depend on rooms, and whose rooms?
Does the space you want carry a venue fee?
Can you swap a package item that doesn't suit you?
When must the music stop?
What is the covered alternative if the wind rises?
